comment: A great team to partner with. Even though there were some hiccups along the way, they remained open to communication and very friendly. They prioritize understanding and honoring your needs and budget. I strongly recommend collaborating with them and look forward to future endeavors together.
Excellent communication and execution.

A real special technical talent and someone we hope to continue working with for future projects! Proactively suggested improvements to existing work items as well as demonstrating excellent communication on availability and challenges that may otherwise be viewed as tough conversations (e.g. "maybe we should do it this way instead") are just a few of the reasons why we enjoy working with Dana!
Dmytro and Petro are detail-oriented and diligent. I would hire them again.
Great team and developer.
Nazar has the uncanny gift of listening to the clients requirments and implementing them to the precision detail. He is a joy to work with. Look forward to working with you again soon!

Svyatoslav was able to come into a relatively complex problem space, understand the project requirements, ask questions when needed, and deliver good quality code on time. It was a pleasure working with him.
Great communication, delivered on time, had good initiative

Svyatoslav is great. Loved every bit of working with him. He solved complex problems for me. also, it's nice he always can get help from simple2b team, for find the best solution. also it was nice to get update or any help I need from Vasyl.
This freelancer has the good skill in Python and ML. We will hire this freelancer again in further projects.
Good value developer. Has good knowledge of Django.

The team did high quality work quickly and effectively. They were very pleasant to work with and I will happily contact them again if I need additional help in the future. I cannot say enough good things about the experience and the deliverables.

Gleb was a very valuable member of the team and he provided a lot of very useful contributions to the project. Despite working 20 hours a week, he was adaptable made himself available for our daily catchup meetings at a time that was suitable for us and the rest of the team.

We experienced professional coding expertise. The freelancer was able to get familiar the existing framework fast and added well structured code to it. The communication before and during the complete project was professional and very good.
Great job completing a difficult project. Communication and oversight were as thorough as the development efforts. It was a pleasure working with this team and we hope to do so again.
Already starting work on our second contract. Very happy with the professionalism, communication, and documentation. The work was stellar.
Great communications and skills. Appreaciated working them the agency. Will definitely hire again. Went the extra mile to fix things that were not working. Thanks!

Nikolay and Simple2B represented themselves in a very professional manner. You don't just get a programmer when you hire them. They project manage, prioritize and deliver the solutions you need. I am a very satisfied client and highly recommend Simple2B.
As always, prompt, professional, and great attention to detail. Great at adapting to changing project requirements, and working through our large and complex code base.

Simple2B did an excellent job in completing the project. They communicated each step of the way to get clarifications, to provide periodic updates and to explain certain technical matters. The development team has very good grasp of the technology know-how, especially with respect to python and docker. Enjoyed working with them and will likely do so in the future if the opportunity arises.

Simple2B braved the perils of the PayPal API and accomplished the task in spite of ugly legacy code, horrible documentation from PayPal, conflicting support responses from PayPal, and worked around our timezone issues to be available for turn-up and deployment. Highly recommended.

Simple2B have delivered an excellent custom script that has simplified my routine work as an SEO specialist significantly. They've adhered to all requirements, and delivered the work in time. Definitely recommend!
Very fast and effective. Very good communication. Very reasonable price per hour. Recommended.
Amazing communication. Understands what needs to be done. Comes with new ideas. Delivers on time. The project was better than what we expected. Will definitely work with them again.
This was phase 2 of our initial work with Simple2B. They completed the work with diligence and I am very satisfied with the results. I would be happy to work with them again.
